metadata.logline: A girl wishes to keep her birthday cake to herself; time freezes, forcing her to eat it all alone until the final bite resets the cycle.

narrative_engine.spark: Innocent micro-sin: Maya secretly wishes she did not have to share her birthday cake with anyone else.
narrative_engine.malicious_grant: Reality arrests: time freezes solid, chatter cuts into dead acoustic vacuum, candle smoke hardens in mid-air.
narrative_engine.visceral_decay: Indulgence turns to sensory torture: involuntary motor control forces rapid ingestion, enamel scraping metal fork, cold lard frosting congealing on tongue, throat muscles convulsing.
narrative_engine.infinite_trap: The final swallow triggers an instantaneous physical snap: plate cleans, whole unblemished cake and lit candle reform in a continuous cycle.

shots_compiled.motion_prompt: Camera: Eye-level medium two-shot tracking subtly forward, 35mm prime lens. Slow camera push-in. Maya blows breath across candle flame. The flame quivers violently, bends horizontally, and snaps off into a thin rising curl of grey smoke. Friends' smiling expressions begin to freeze.

foley_cues.description: Subdued residential party murmur, gentle clapping, two muffled laughs.
Focused exhale hiss through pursed lips, ending with candle wick fizzle.

davinci_marker.note: Cut on flame extinction at 3.5s. Sound drops instantly to dead vacuum.

foley_cues.description: Tactile dull drag of steel blade slicing through dense moist sponge cake.
Ceramic clink of fork landing, heavy wet slap of buttercream frosting.
Quiet, isolated mouth chew and single gentle swallow in dead room tone.

davinci_marker.name: Beat 03: The First Bite
davinci_marker.note: Transition from curious calm into mechanical acceleration.
